name: phygital-plus
description: Phygital+ generation models over MCP: pick a model, read its live input schema, hand over a file, start a generation and wait for the result.

interface.longDescription: Runs Phygital+ generative models from the agent: pick a model from the live catalog, build its input from the model's own JSON Schema, upload a file, start a generation and wait for the result. Every call runs on your Phygital+ account and spends its credits.
